visualCharacteristics.layout: Fixed pill dock at the bottom right (teal, shield icon, label, pulsing dot) that opens a 480px full-height side sheet on the right (full width on phones): header (title, round bordered Back/Close), scrolling body, footer that follows short content

animation.selector: aside.m-dock-0pqo-G (dock), div.m-sheetOverlay-sVRLB9 > div.m-modal-2sZkF4.m-sheet-7FP-Ve[data-size=side] > section[role=dialog] (sheet), div.m-illustration-iXIyDh[data-construct] > svg (tile art)
animation.elementType: DOM + inline SVG (procedural isometric renderer in the source bundle)
animation.dataAttributes: dock: data-visible, data-motion; sheet: data-step=form|recommend|sales; art: data-construct=building|resolved
animation.externalAssets: Illustrations exported from the source renderer to /assets/shipping-insurance/quote/*.svg (carriers, shield-alone, parcel-shield, freight, luxury-goods, merchants-protected, coverage-shield, coverage-unsure, product-shipping-insurance, product-parcelpro, email-verify, logo-insureshield, logo-parcel-pro)
animation.depicts: Isometric teal/grey objects per choice (planes and trucks, shields, parcels, freight pallets, luxury case, storefront, safe, envelope)
animation.howItAnimates: Dock fades and rises 16px in (200ms) once scrolled past 60% of the hero, pulse ping 1.28s infinite. Sheet slides in from the right (320ms enter easing), backdrop fades to 50% #363230. Later questions reveal (0fr to 1fr, 320ms). Each illustration constructs over 900ms when 30% visible: items pop in staggered, colour fills up from a ghost palette, emblems draw, dashed guides fade in and out. Checkbox fill wipe + tick draw, radio ring thickens
animation.dimensions: sheet 480 x 100dvh; tile art 100% x 72px (96 x 64 in single-column rows on phones); offer art 144 x 120; sales art 100% x 120
animation.migrationNote: The sheet is not in the scraped DOM (rendered on demand). The parser reads the dock label and emits the drawer content from constants captured from the live source

visualCharacteristics.interactive: Listbox select, two dual-thumb range sliders (crossing handles, draggable band), radio/checkbox tiles, other-provider field, live monthly estimate, recommendation routing (Connect, Complete, for UPS, Parcel Pro), sign-up hand-off URL, talk-to-sales form with validation (sends to the contact page here)

contentPattern.surroundingText: Own last section; no visible content in the page flow
rows: Stops / Default / Format / Open ended / Help list
Note / Low rate / High rate list
field labels, errors, Send, Privacy, Contact page

usage: Persistent quote entry point: floating dock plus a multi-step quote side sheet, also opened by the hero calculator CTAs.
reuseGuidance: Use once per page, in the last section. Other blocks open it with the cancelable document event 'quote-drawer:open' (detail: entry 'estimate' or 'sales', values [min, max]). Option and product ids drive the recommendation rules; labels, images and links are authored.
